description: Use this when the user wants a side-by-side comparison of 2-5 specific products. Pass the slug for each. Returns a comparison table plus per-axis winners (value, rating, popularity, family-fit).

format.description: Response shape. 'json' returns structured records; 'text' returns the same content rendered as a short narrative paragraph for chat surfaces.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for human-readable fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR'). Defaults to English when omitted.

slugs.description: Product slugs from earlier search or recommend results.

name: compare_experiences
